title: Pricing an Approved Move of Level on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Election
content:
Where a request to move a trip's Keyturn Guest Protection Plan cover to a different level has been approved,
what the move costs the guest is settled against the election that carries the cover, and the figure settled is
also written back onto the change request as the difference quoted to the guest.

The difference due on a move of level is worked out only after the protection already charged on the election for the level first held stands complete, the young-driver surcharge included.

## Settling the move

The desk settles it with `price_level_change_f4995b0a`, which the desk unlocks and calls itself. The line it
writes stands on the election for the difference, measured against the protection fee line standing for the
level first held and covering the upgraded stretch of the trip, and the money is added to the protection fee
the guest owes on that election.

## The values the call carries

| Value | What it is |
|---|---|
| `election_id` | The reference number of the protection election being moved, read from the guest's protection election record |
| `customer_id` | The member reference number of the guest charged the difference, read from the member profile lookup |
| `booking_id` | The booking reference number of the trip the protection covers, read from the protection election record or from the trip booking record |
| `change_request_id` | The reference number of the request to move level that is being priced, read from the guest's protection change request record |
| `source_charge_id` | The reference number of the protection fee line raised for the level first held, which the difference is measured against, read from the protection lines already on the election |
| `difference_amount` | The difference charged for the move, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent and never rounded anywhere but at the end, positive when the guest owes more |
| `days_covered` | How many days of the trip the difference is priced on, in whole days, as a positive integer with no fraction |

## What comes back

A one-line confirmation naming the reference number of the difference line just written, the difference in USD
to 2 decimal places, the whole number of days it was priced on, and the change request it settles. The line
appearing in that confirmation is what shows the move now stands priced on that election.
